blocks.prompt: 2 (a) Find the local linear approximation of \(f(x) = \sin x\) at \(x = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh centre \(x = 0\) par linearization ka sawal hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \sin x\) aur centre 0. Find kya karna hai? \(L(x)\).
Centre 0 kyun aasaan hai? Kyun ke \(\sin 0 = 0\) aur \(\cos 0 = 1\) zubani maloom hain.
Plan: \(f(0)\), \(f'(0)\), phir formula mein rakh dena.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sin x\), centre \(a = 0\).
Maloom karna: \(L(x)\).
Tareeqa: \(L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\), wohi linearization ka formula.

Centre par value aur slope
\[f(0) = \sin 0 = 0\]
\[f'(x) = \cos x,\ f'(0) = \cos 0 = 1\]
Kyun: \(\sin x\) ka derivative \(\cos x\) hai, jab \(x\) radians mein ho. Slope 1 ka matlab: origin par sine ka graph \(45^\circ\) par uthta hai.

Linearization
\[L(x) = 0 + 1(x - 0) = x\]
Yani \(x = 0\) ke qareeb \(\sin x \approx x\) (\(x\) radians mein).
Kyun: origin par \(y = \sin x\) ki tangent line \(y = x\) hi hai. Yeh mashhoor "small angle approximation" hai jo physics mein bhi aata hai.

Tasdeeq
\(\sin 0.1 = 0.0998\), jo \(0.1\) ke bohat qareeb hai. Formula theek kaam kar raha hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(L(x) = x\), yani \(x = 0\) ke qareeb \(\sin x \approx x\).

blocks.prompt: 2 (b) Use the local linear approximation obtained in part (a) to approximate \(\sin 2^\circ\), and compare your approximation to the result produced directly by a calculator.
blocks.explanation:
Part (a) ka \(\sin x \approx x\) use karna hai.
Diya kya hai? Angle \(2^\circ\), degrees mein. Find kya karna hai? \(\sin 2^\circ\) ka andaza aur calculator se muqabla.
Sab se zaroori baat: formula sirf radians ke liye sahi hai, is liye pehle \(2^\circ\) ko radians mein badlenge.
Plan: radians, \(L(x)\) mein rakhna, calculator se muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya: 0 ke qareeb \(\sin x \approx x\) (part (a)); angle \(2^\circ\).
Maloom karna: \(\sin 2^\circ\) ka andaza aur calculator se muqabla.
Tareeqa: radians mein badlein, phir \(L(x) = x\) lagayein.

Radians mein badlein
\[2^\circ = 2 \times \dfrac{\pi}{180} = \dfrac{\pi}{90}\]
\[\approx 0.0349066\]
Kyun: \(L(x) = x\) radians ke liye bana tha. 0.0349 zero ke bohat qareeb hai, is liye andaza acha aayega.
Dhyan dein: \(x = 2\) rakh kar \(\sin 2^\circ \approx 2\) likhna bilkul ghalat hai; sine kabhi 1 se bara nahi hota.

Andaza
\[\sin 2^\circ \approx \dfrac{\pi}{90} \approx 0.0349066\]
Kyun: \(L(x) = x\), to jo radian value hai wahi sine ka andaza hai.

Calculator se muqabla
\[\sin 2^\circ = 0.0348995\]
\[\text{Error} = 0.0349066 - 0.0348995\]
\[= 0.0000071\]
Dono values chaar decimal places tak milti hain (dono 0.0349): andaza behtareen hai, kyun ke \(2^\circ\) centre 0 ke bohat qareeb hai.
